title: Lakeside Painters at Waterfall
description: A serene fantasy landscape shows two women in sun hats painting at easels on the shore of a calm lake. In the distance, a small rowboat floats on the reflective water while a towering waterfall cascades beside a metal lattice tower atop a rocky cliff.
prompt: A peaceful fantasy landscape featuring a large waterfall flowing into a reflective lake with a small wooden rowboat carrying a lone figure. Two women wearing sun hats stand in the foreground painting on easels. A tall metal lattice tower stands on the cliff above the falls, surrounded by pine trees. Distant mountains under a colorful sky with multiple moons and a glowing sun, soft mist and vibrant reflections on the water.
